params.callbackProxy_: The chain's Reactive Network callback proxy.
params.pool_: The pool whose Swap events drive the reactive contract.
params.reactive_: The LimitOrderReactive contract allowed to trigger executions.
params.tokenA_: Token deposited by traders (sold into tokenB on execution).

params.amountIn_: Token A amount to sell (approve this vault first).
params.targetPrice_: Execute when the pool price of A (B per A, 1e18-scaled) falls to or below this.

execute(address,uint256,uint256).details: The network injects the reactive contract address as `rvm_id`;      `observedPrice` is what the reactive contract saw in the Swap event,      re-verified here against live pool state before any funds move.

pay(uint256).details: Make sure to check the msg.sender.

params.amount_: Amount owed due to reactive transactions and/or callbacks.

_CALLBACK_SENDER().notice: Address of the reactive contract allowed to send callbacks.

_SERVICE_PROVIDER().notice: Service provider contract allowed to request payments.

cancelOrder(uint256).notice: Cancel an open order and take the deposit back.

createOrder(uint256,uint256).notice: Deposit token A and set the target price. Emits the event the reactive contract mirrors.

currentPrice().notice: Current pool price of token A (B per A, 1e18-scaled).

execute(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Reactive-callback only: execute the order through the pool.

pay(uint256).notice: Method called by the system contract and/or proxies when payment is due.
